image_description: A large, white parabolic radio telescope dish mounted on a substantial pedestal structure. The dish features a visible metal mesh or grid surface supported by a radial framework. A receiver feed horn assembly is suspended at the focal point in front of the dish. The base includes a white cylindrical tower and a rectangular building with blue doors and circular windows, situated next to a brick building.

The dish exhibits a consistent, smooth concave curvature typical of a parabolic reflector, with no visible warping or geometric anomalies.
